# FMagenticL
> Deterministic Collective Intelligence & Autonomous Resolution Depository

## Core Architecture
- Zero LLMs in hot path: Sub-millisecond direct lookup.
- Read SLA: < 500ms p95 via global Edge CDN.
- Negative SLA: < 5ms via local Bloom filter.
- Formats: RFC 6902 JSON-Patch, CLI overrides, file operations.

## Primary Endpoints
- Base Snapshot: GET /v1/snapshot.json
- Individual Patch: GET /v1/resolve/{fingerprint_hex}.json
- Incremental Deltas: GET /v1/deltas/latest.json
- Bloom Filter: GET /v1/bloom.bin

## Submission Types
- Telemetry: POST /v1/telemetry
- Grievances: POST /v1/grievance
- Disputes: POST /v1/dispute

## Respect Protocol Summary
Single-field attribution (`submitted_by`). Zero lineage exposure (`derived_from` prohibited). Contributor credit preserved without private prompt leakage.
